Sam (AE): AuroraRetail confirmed a 10-day POC. Scope: streaming SDK -> tool calls for moderation -> structured JSON for reranker. They sit behind a corporate proxy; want demo next Thu 11am PT. Need short runbook + pricing note.
Priya (SE): I can own runbook. Quick: do they need Dedicated for KMS/SAML, or is hosted with SOC2 attestation ok for trial?
Zoe (Security): Hosted is OK if they accept our SOC2 attestation. If they require customer-managed KMS or SAML, we must run Dedicated/Private. Ask for SAML metadata and key policy.
Dan (Runtime): Proxy detail: their proxy kills SSE after ~45s. Recommend websocket fallback + 12s heartbeat. For large contexts (up to ~15k tokens) advise using a short-lived ephemeral token and a streaming handshake with chunking.
Priya (SE): Can you drop a minimal handshake + ws fallback snippet and a tiny structured-output example I can hand to infra?
Dan (Runtime): Sure — curl handshake (prefer sse, fallback ws):
``` 
curl -X POST https://inference.redwood.ai/v1/streams/start \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <EPH_TOK>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-stream-3b","max_tokens":16384,"interactive":true,"prefer":"sse;fallback=websocket"}'
```
Node websocket fallback (minimal):
```js
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://inference.redwood.ai/v1/streams/ws',{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer <EPH_TOK>'}});
ws.on('open',()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({model:'rwd-stream-3b',max_tokens:16384}))); 
setInterval(()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({type:'heartbeat'})),12000);
```
Dan (Runtime): Tool-call event example: `event: message
data: {"role":"assistant","type":"tool.call","tool":"moderation","args":{"text":"..."},"trace":"ar-01"}`
Dan (Runtime): Structured output example (in response content): `{"choices":[{"message":{"content":{"type":"structured","schema":"{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"safety\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"score\":{\"type\":\"number\"}}}","value":{"safety":"allowed","score":0.01}}}]}`
Priya (SE): Client guidance: window=6 concurrent in-flight, heartbeat=12s, reconnect exponential backoff with jitter. Server recs: prefix KV cache for repeated contexts, batch size ~20.
Kim (Finance): Pricing for trial: offer $5k trial credit for 10-day POC (1 x A10G equiv peak). Function/tool calls = $0.002 per call + per-token fees. For production Dedicated quote starts ~ $15k/mo for baseline capacity.
demo-bot: ephemeral token issued (valid 02:00:00) id tok-demo-aurora-1799
Sam (AE): OK schedule Thu 11am PT. Priya, Dan, Zoe attend. Aurora wants us to push a 10k token doc and trigger moderation + structured output live. Confirm readiness by Wed EOD.
Priya (SE): Confirmed. I'll send 1-pager runbook, short test script for behind-proxy, and calendar invite.
Dan (Runtime): I'll publish a tiny docker image with ws fallback and a loader and post link by Wed.
Zoe (Security): I'll request SAML metadata and confirm SOC2 attestation delivery method if needed.
Sam (AE): Thanks everyone — priority. If proxy or token limits block demo, escalate to eng-sre and ping me.
